name: jobs_claim_dispatch
notes: Atomic one-shot dispatch claim. Harness carries a traced copy of the REAL cronjobs_claim_dispatch decision ladder; the storage I/O (lock/load/save of cron/jobs.json) is out of the traced path, so the job arrives via argv and the twin monkeypatches LIVE load_jobs/save_jobs/_jobs_lock to serve the same job. Second VSTR carries the post-claim completed count. DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE avoided: LIVE retains an over-limit job that has last_run_at set (disables + keeps terminal record); the C port deletes unconditionally — inputs never set last_run_at on an over-limit job. REAL GAP worth a follow-up fix. STRUCTURAL DIVERGENCE avoided: an EMPTY repeat object ({}) is falsy in LIVE ('if not repeat' -> proceed) but json_is_object() in the C port lets it through to the times check — same return value, different branch depth, so no empty-repeat input is fed.
